Two slices, says SerleenaHow to make it500g pizza dough100ml pizza sauce150g mozzarella, grated16 slices of pepperoni2 tbsp plain flour, for dustingHeat the oven to 230°C with a tray inside.Roll out the dough on a bench dusted with the plain flour and cut into rounds.Spread each round with sauce, then add mozzarella and a slice of pepperoni.Bake on the hot tray until the bases are crisp and the cheese bubbles.Truro post office sausage rollsPork and fennel rolls, by Kevin Brown, postmasterHow to make it500g pork mince1 brown onion, grated1 tsp fennel seeds40g dried breadcrumbs2 eggs3 sheets of frozen puff pastry, thawed125ml tomato sauceHeat the oven to 200°C and line two trays.Mix the pork, onion, fennel seeds, breadcrumbs, 1 egg and a good pinch of salt and pepper.Cut each pastry sheet in half. Lay a log of filling along each half, roll up and press the seam down underneath.Cut each roll into 4, brush with the other egg, beaten, and bake for 25 minutes until golden and cooked through.Serve hot with tomato sauce.Garlic knots with parmesanOne for Scrad, one for Charlie.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.Hot messBen's Famous pizzaAsk Ben about the Light of Zartha.
